summary.plain: The second general-purpose detector at SLAC. It started at the SPEAR ring in 1977, moved to the larger PEP ring in 1979, and in 1987 became the first detector on the Stanford Linear Collider, where it saw its first Z boson decay in April 1989.
summary.technical: Mark II: SLAC-LBL solenoidal general-purpose detector, successor of the Mark I; SPEAR (1977-79, 7 GeV storage ring), PEP (from 1979, 29 GeV), upgraded and tested at PEP in 1985, installed in the Collider Hall in 1986, on the SLC beamline from 1987 (first Z decay 11 April 1989; about 500 Z decays and 19 nb⁻¹ by December 1989); about 130 physicists from nine institutions in 1989; moved off the beamline in 1990.
